specification.defenseHandoff: Fund the hall first, then retain real defense until the post is independently covered. Count already assigned local defenders. Never keep a second unit roster.
specification.recruitment: Recovering melee first, recovering ranged second, healthy escorts last. Select by actual strength, not a fixed guard count. A remote army still leaves a recovering soldier present.
specification.towerAdmission: Buy a tower only if the closest plausible raid exceeds recovering/established defense. No tax when existing guards are sufficient or the enemy army is more than 45 native-road seconds away.
specification.temporaryEscorts: Healthy construction escorts are marked in unitClaims and released after the actual replacement defense is present. Recovering guards remain recognized after healing.
specification.recovery: Safe recovery remains at the mining post; immediate danger may still cause an escape. Far healing posts cannot repeatedly borrow a mine garrison.
specification.nextObjective: With a garrison committed, rank unready mine camps by their missing reinforcement force. Clear a camp that actually blocks the expedition road as a prerequisite of the same mine; retain the parent mine through that child task.
